lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately vertical columns across the lateral flank posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal features on the upper flank exhibiting a high-contrast luminance gradient (bright superior edge, dark inferior shadow).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: High-luminance blobs are distributed across the visible lateral surface of the first dorsal fin, with higher density observed toward the leading edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density population of smaller-diameter high-luminance blobs compared to the lateral flank.
